data.raw_text:
[6:16PM] #Vi #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic movement from McWen bridge inward Bonny Camp roundabout is moving well at the moment. Traffic movement descending from Bonny camp bridge Inward Ahmadu Bello way down to Adeola Odeku is encouraging same as the return journey back to Bonny camp is a moving traffic.
Vehicular movement from Adeola Odeku connecting Adetokunbo Ademola enroute Eko Hotel roundabout is moving traffic while traffic build up approaching Eko Hotel roundabout due to high influx and alternating point at the roundabout.
Eko Hotel enroute Sanusi Fafunwa is a moving traffic.
Vehicular movement from Bonny camp under bridge enroute Kofo Abayomi is good.
Kofo Abayomi inward Oniru Kilimajaro is busy but moving due to high influx with alternations.
Vehicular movement from Kilimanjaro enroute Akin Adeshola, Law School enroute Civic Center is busy but moving traffic.
Civic Centre inward BJ1004 is busy moving traffic due high influx. Vehicular movement from BJ enroute school corner down to Sandfill is a moving traffic.
Immediately after Sandfill it’s an appreciable vehicular movement down to Lekki Phase1. The return journey from Lekki enroute Sandfill connecting School corner is good, BJ inward civic Centre is a moving traffic.
Civic center is building up, while inward Law School connecting Akin Adeshola is encouraging. Akin Adeshola inward Kilimanjaro is a moving traffic, Kilimanjaro to Kofo is encouraging.
Kofoabayomi inward Bonny camp roundabout down to McWen is slightly busy but moving traffic coupled with alteration underneath Bonny camp bridge.

#FollowLASTMA

[6:43PM] #Anthony #TrafficUpdate 

There is a traffic build-up from Town Planning Junction extending along the Ikorodu Road corridor, now reaching close to the Independence Tunnel.
The congestion is due to a partial road closure caused by police escort for a VIP movement, affecting the link from Town Planning to Anthony Oke.

#FollowLASTMA
